environment: Isolated Docker Compose Coturn and mediasoup with temporary random credentials and a private host-reachable IPv4 address. Existing application, database, Redis, and media containers were not restarted.

assertions: both Chromium participants selected a TURN relay candidate
microphone, camera, shared-screen video, and shared-screen audio RTP flowed through the SFU
stopping Coturn interrupted both ICE connections
restarting Coturn restored ICE, relay selection, and both call-ready states
distance exit revoked remote media and leaving cleaned up media resources

media_unit_suite.command: docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint node hufs-town-turn-e2e-media:latest --test test/*.test.mjs

limitations: The relay used a private host-reachable route, not the production Oracle public IP or firewall path.
No mobile carrier or external Internet client was tested.
The host pnpm runner remains blocked by its mediasoup build-script policy; the complete media unit suite passed inside the Docker image where the native worker is built.
